character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After escaping his captors and uncovering encrypted coordinates, Kael survived an ambush at a rail yard by halting a train with his engineered powers. Discovering that his former mentor Commander Vance is the mastermind behind the syndicate, Kael tracked Vance to an underground laboratory. Trapped by Vance's security protocols and dropped over a glowing energy chasm, Kael barely held on as Vance escaped, leaving the hero to fight his way out of a deeper conspiracy.
